items.title: Network Development Engineer, Data Center Fabrics
items.location_text: Paris, Amsterdam, Warsaw, Munich, London, Berlin
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Network Development Engineer, Data Center Fabrics, you will help design and build systems for operating large-scale networks within our data centers. You will apply deep networking expertise to leaf-spine architecture, automation, testing, and production troubleshooting across Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRFs. This is a hands-on role for a networking expert who is also comfortable building production software. Go and Kubernetes experience are helpful but not required; strong engineering fundamentals and network automation experience matter more. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and evolve leaf-spine underlays, EVPN/VXLAN overlays, and tenant connectivity for multi-tenant AI infrastructure. - Translate data-center fabric requirements and safety properties into clear APIs, data models, validation, and automation. - Build reliable control-plane software that reconciles desired and observed network state. - Design safe change workflows with validation, dry runs, atomic updates, observability, and failure recovery. - Integrate with data-center switch operating systems and management APIs while maintaining vendor-neutral abstractions where practical. - Participate in the on-call rotation, troubleshoot active data-center network incidents, restore service, and turn root causes into lasting improvements. - Review designs and code, explain networking trade-offs, and help raise network engineering quality across the organization. - Develop lab and production tests and turn operational lessons into better software and architecture. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Deep hands-on experience with Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP-based leaf-spine fabrics, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRF-based multitenancy. - Strong judgment around fabric underlay and overlay design, scale, convergence, isolation, and failure modes. - Experience building or operating production network automation, including desired state, idempotency, concurrency, observability, and recovery. - Strong software-engineering fundamentals in a general-purpose language. You can design, test, debug, and review production systems and are willing to become productive in Go. - Experience with southbound network APIs and structured configuration, such as REST, gNMI/OpenConfig, or NETCONF. - Hands-on experience with major data-center network operating systems, such as Cumulus Linux, Arista EOS, SONiC, Junos, or NX-OS. - Strong diagnostic skills using routing and EVPN state, packet captures, counters, telemetry, and logs. - Clear, pragmatic communication and a collaborative approach to technical leadership. NICE TO HAVE - Experience reading, reviewing, or contributing to Go code. - Familiarity with Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, reconciliation, or Kubebuilder. - Experience with physical or simulated network labs such as containerlab, NVIDIA Air, EVE-NG, GNS3, or similar environments. - Experience with high-performance Ethernet, RoCE, InfiniBand, HPC, or large-scale GPU infrastructure. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. THE ROLE As a Network Development Engineer - WAN & Edge, you will design, automate, and operate resilient connectivity between data centers, cloud environments, external networks, and the internet. Your work will span routing, firewalls, traffic engineering, and production troubleshooting. This is a hands-on role for an experienced network engineer who can build, test, debug, and review production-grade automation. Networking depth and strong software-engineering judgment matter more than familiarity with any particular language, platform, or tool. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and evolve resilient inter-site, cloud, and internet connectivity for large-scale AI infrastructure. - Own external BGP policy and traffic engineering at the edge, including route filtering, failover, and capacity planning. - Build API-driven automation for edge routing, firewalls, VPNs, carrier connectivity, and network segmentation. - Coordinate with carriers, cloud connectivity providers, colocation partners, and vendors on design, provisioning, incident escalation, and service improvement. - Design safe change workflows with automated validation and resilience testing, staged rollouts, observability, rollback, and recovery. - Participate in on-call rotation, troubleshoot active WAN and edge incidents, restore service, and turn root causes into lasting improvements. - Review designs and code, explain networking trade-offs, and help raise network engineering quality across the organization. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Deep, hands-on WAN and edge networking experience across internet connectivity, data-center interconnect, private WAN, or cloud networking. - A track record of taking external BGP designs from whiteboard to production and debugging them during production incidents. - Experience integrating and troubleshooting stateful firewalls, NAT, asymmetric routing, and redundant edge designs on at least one major routing or firewall platform. - Experience building or operating production network automation using network-management APIs and data models. You understand desired state and idempotency; relevant technologies might include REST, NETCONF, gNMI/OpenConfig, Ansible, or Terraform. - Strong software-engineering fundamentals in a general-purpose language. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with FortiGate, FortiManager, or comparable edge and firewall platforms. - Deeper specialization in external connectivity, such as public-cloud or hybrid-cloud interconnect, or internet transit and peering. - Exposure to edge security and scale techniques such as RPKI and route-origin validation, DDoS mitigation, or global traffic engineering. - Familiarity with streaming telemetry, network source-of-truth systems, and configuration-compliance tooling. - Experience reading, reviewing, or contributing to Go code. - Familiarity with Kubernetes controllers, operators, or other declarative, reconciliation-based systems. items.title: Product Manager, Interactive Avatars (Staff/Principal-level - SDKs, APIs)
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. ABOUT THE ROLE For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back. We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there. It's early. Interactive Avatars has just come out of closed beta, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on. This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta. THE PROBLEM YOU'RE SOLVING Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build. We have the avatar technology and a working early version. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles - Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them - Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves - Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time - Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job - Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business WHO YOU ARE You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly. You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes. You care about the detail, and you can hold a quality bar for something subjective and hard: a real-time avatar either feels present and responsive or it feels off, and the difference lives in latency, interruption handling, expressiveness, and consistency. You know how to make that bar concrete and defend it. You think commercially. A new API isn't just a technical surface. It's a business, and you have instincts (or scar tissue) around how developer products get adopted, packaged, and monetized. REQUIREMENTS: - 5+ years in product, with direct experience owning a developer-facing API, SDK, or platform product. The vertical doesn't matter, the platform depth does - Comfortable operating in an early-stage, 0→1 environment where discovery and delivery happen in parallel and the roadmap is still being shaped - Strong technical fluency: you can hold a credible conversation with engineers about real-time systems, latency, and integration trade-offs, and make good calls without needing every answer handed to you - Strong written communication: you can write a spec, a strategy doc, or an API design rationale that others can act on without a follow-up conversation - Real-time / streaming media, conversational AI, or applied-AI product experience is a strong plus but not a prerequisite. - Instinct for the commercial side of a developer product - adoption, packaging, and monetization is a plus. - Based in London or open to regular in-person time. OUR CULTURE At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. https://www.notion.so/How-we-work-at-Synthesia-f794caa72f8446efb6be22b551ce0fa2?pvs=21 LOCATION Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office. GLOBAL BENEFITS: - You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity. - You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays. - Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person. - Work from home budget - Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year - Generous referral scheme - Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater—our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit) BENEFITS SPECIFIC TO UK: - Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants - 5% pension match - Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office - Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

items.title: Staff MarTech Manager
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. As the Lead for Robinhood's Marketing Technology team, you'll set the technical direction for a world class Marketing Technology stack and help grow the team that builds it. Our mission is to enhance, build and transform systems for the global Marketing organization, in partnership with product and engineering. We are building a best-in-class, privacy-first MarTech stack from the ground up. Performance marketers, lifecycle marketers and the global Marketing organization are our customers. They rely on us to drive KPIs across Acquisition, Activation, Engagement and Retention. You'll turn their needs into scalable technical solutions, working closely with product, engineering, data engineering and data science teams. As Lead, you will own the architecture and technical roadmap of our MarTech platform, with a particular focus on our composable CDP and reverse ETL ecosystem. You'll make the key design decisions, set the standards the team builds against, and be the go-to partner for stakeholders across Marketing and Engineering. You'll also mentor the Platform Managers on the team, raising the bar for everyone. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Own the technical vision, architecture and roadmap for our MarTech platform, including our composable CDP and reverse ETL ecosystem. Make and document key design decisions and tradeoffs. Design & Build AI first systems to streamline operations across the team. Set the standard for how marketing data is modeled, governed and moved between tools. Define the patterns, conventions and best practices the team builds against. Partner with Marketing, product, data engineering and data science leaders to translate business goals into scalable, privacy-first technical solutions and a prioritized backlog. Lead the design and delivery of complex integrations, custom scripts and pipelines, working with data engineering and 3rd party solutions teams. Be accountable for the accuracy, uptime, reliability and observability of our martech integrations. Establish monitoring, alerting and incident response practices, and lead root-cause analysis on platform issues. Mentor and coach Platform Managers on the team to help grow their skills. Raise the team’s technical bar: quality and rigor around measurement, rollouts. Evaluate new MarTech tools and vendors, and advise leadership on build vs. buy decisions. What you bring 7+ years of professional experience in marketing technology, including 2+ years in a lead or senior individual contributor role. Deep hands-on experience designing and operating data integrations, pipelines or customer data platforms at scale. A track record of mentoring and developing other technical team members, and of leading projects through technical design reviews. Sound understanding of data privacy, governance and security practices for customer data. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a bias towards action and strong ownership. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $166,000 — $195,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $146,000 — $172,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $129,000 — $152,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Growth Engineering team builds the experiences that connect people to our ecosystem for the first time and keeps them coming back. We design and ship the systems behind our marketing funnels, signup and KYC flows, and the key engagement features that help new users fund their accounts and explore our products. It’s a team with direct influence on company growth, global reach, and user engagement at scale. Our products serve millions of users globally. As an Engineering Manager, you’ll guide a cross-functional engineering team responsible for delivering measurable impact on growth metrics. You’ll work closely with Product and Design partners to plan, prioritize, and execute projects that accelerate user acquisition, activation, and retention. items.title: International Infrastructure Accounting
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role: Anthropic is seeking an International Infrastructure Accounting professional to join our Infrastructure Accounting team. Based in Dublin and reporting to the Head of International Infrastructure Accounting, you will execute day-to-day accounting for the leased and owned infrastructure supporting Anthropic's expansion outside the United States, i.e. the data centers, network infrastructure, and compute capacity underpinning our international growth. As we continue our rapid growth, you will help ensure the operational scalability and financial accuracy of the core functions that enable Anthropic's research and commercial success. This is an opportunity to be at the heart of one of the fastest-scaling companies in the industry, and to shape how Anthropic's growing international infrastructure portfolio is accounted for and understood across the business. You will own end-to-end accounting for Anthropic's international infrastructure portfolio, with an initial focus on leases, working closely with cross-functional partners across Data Center Operations, Real Estate, Finance, and Legal. You'll apply deep technical accounting expertise under ASC 842 for the US GAAP books, and carry those same arrangements through to the IFRS 16 or local GAAP books. You will partner closely with our central team to ensure global policies, processes, and controls are applied consistently as each new market comes online. Responsibilities: Lead end-to-end accounting for Anthropic's international infrastructure portfolio — leased and owned, with an initial focus on leases — including monthly close, reconciliations, roll-forwards, and flux analysis Apply technical accounting expertise to complex infrastructure arrangements under ASC 842 (lease classification, measurement, modifications, embedded leases, and reassessments) and ASC 360 (capitalization, useful lives, impairment, and disposals) Prepare the US GAAP to IFRS 16 and local GAAP adjustments for each international entity, and partner with our International Statutory Reporting team and external providers so the statutory accounts are accurate and filed on time Partner with Real Estate, Legal, and Finance teams during contract negotiation and execution to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made Serve as a trusted finance partner to non-finance stakeholders — explaining the financial statement impact of their decisions in clear, simple terms they can act on Apply global infrastructure accounting policies, processes, and controls consistently as each new market comes online Help stand up the accounting foundations for each new market, i.e. entity and chart of accounts mapping, functional currency, intercompany flows, and lease system onboarding Collaborate cross-functionally to improve the quality of upstream data pipelines from operational and contract systems, particularly around contract terms, asset receipt, deployment, and in-service dates Collaborate with and mentor accounting professionals across the Infrastructure Accounting team Serve as a key point of contact with external auditors and local statutory auditors on international infrastructure matters Drive process improvements and automation, including leveraging AI tooling, to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of financial reporting Minimum Requirements: Have 10+ years of progressive experience in accounting, with operational experience at technology or infrastructure-heavy companies Are a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent) with a bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent practical experience Possess strong technical accounting knowledge of ASC 842 and ASC 360, particularly as applied to infrastructure, data center, or compute-related arrangements Have worked across both US GAAP and IFRS, and are comfortable owning the differences rather than handing them off Have experience managing a significant lease or fixed asset portfolio in a high-growth environment Demonstrate strong analytical abilities and comfort working with large, complex datasets Have a track record of improving scalable financial processes in fast-moving environments Have experience mentoring and developing accounting professionals Are adept at translating technical accounting concepts into financial implications for non-finance stakeholders Communicate clearly and influence effectively across cross-functional partners and time zones Have experience partnering with engineering, infrastructure, or operations teams to improve financial reporting and cost transparency Preferred Requirements: Experience at hyperscalers, large compute consumers, data center operators, or telecommunications companies with exposure to infrastructure lease or asset structures (including colocation, dark fiber IRUs, GPU clusters, networking equipment, and data center buildouts) Experience with lease accounting software and / or fixed asset subledger systems at scale Experience with statutory reporting across multiple jurisdictions, including working with external providers and local audits Experience supporting a US-headquartered multinational from a regional or European finance hub SQL proficiency for querying and analyzing large infrastructure and accounting datasets Background in Big 4 accounting or advisory services combined with industry experience Experience with complex data center buildouts or hybrid cloud / on-premise environments Knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure and associated cost structures Experience applying AI tooling (including Claude) to accounting processes, memo drafting, or close automation Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and drive results in rapidly changing environments The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: €140.000 — €170.000 EUR Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Manager, Applied AI Architects (Australia)
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Applied AI Architect team partners with organisations to turn OpenAI’s most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams. ABOUT THE ROLE As the Manager of Applied AI Architects, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for a portfolio of OpenAI customers across Australia and New Zealand. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact. You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will prioritise customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth. You will remain accountable for the team’s technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between regional strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching. This role is based in Sydney, Australia. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, building experienced architects’ autonomy, leadership, and architectural judgement while maintaining high standards of accountability, continuous learning, and customer stewardship. - Independently define and refine your team’s strategy, priorities, and operating model, aligning company priorities, customer needs, and the ANZ go-to-market while balancing near-term execution with long-term team capability. - Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritise accounts and opportunities, make complex resource-allocation decisions, and establish clear technical strategies for your team’s portfolio. - Ensure Applied AI Architects serve as the primary technical advisors for their portfolios, owning technical account plans, technical milestones, adoption priorities, account health, and expansion opportunities. - Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production. - Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment. - Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, as well as senior AI, technology, data, security, and engineering leaders, serving as an executive technical sponsor when needed. - Mobilise Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, partners, and other specialists to remove blockers and deliver a cohesive customer experience. - Remain accountable for the team’s technical progress and customer outcomes, while agreeing clear owners, milestones and handoffs with Deployment, Implementation and Enablement teams for the work they execute. - Establish a rigorous view of portfolio health, including technical wins, qualified use cases, production readiness, adoption, usage, risks, measurable customer impact, and the technical contribution to growth. - Translate patterns from the field into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Research, and go-to-market teams, while developing reusable architecture guidance and customer practices. - Build a culture that balances ambitious customer outcomes with responsible AI deployment, clear ownership, thoughtful prioritisation, and effective specialist handoffs. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Possess deep technical acumen in modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, platform technologies, software and cloud architecture, APIs, data integration, identity, security, privacy, evaluation, and enterprise deployment. - Bring 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical consulting, including work with large and complex enterprises. - Have 4+ years of people-management experience hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing technical teams. - Have guided enterprise organisations from technical discovery and evaluation through production adoption, healthy usage, and measurable business impact. - Demonstrate outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, boards, business leaders, and hands-on engineers. - Can lead a complex portfolio, make thoughtful resource-allocation decisions, and balance regional strategy with hands-on support for critical customer engagements. - Exercise strong architectural judgement, including knowing when to go deep personally, when to coach the team, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership. - Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Deployment, Customer Engagement, Security, Legal, Privacy, and external partner ecosystems. - Embody a customer-centric philosophy focused on durable value, responsible production adoption, technical excellence, and long-term partnership. - Approach your work with humility, curiosity, a collaborative spirit, and a deep commitment to the safe and beneficial advancement of AI. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. You will be part of preparing our journey to containerization, increasing the scalability of our systems while also maintaining their high quality. You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform to support 25+ online brands! Our brands are used by hundreds of thousands of users and growing To sum it up: you will be taking our Gaming platform, which is used by a worldwide audience, to a new level! You are a collaborative person who readily offers help and shares knowledge with your colleagues. C#, .NET Framework, NET Core 8 .NET Core Web API SQL Server and NoSQL databases Messaging services within a microservice architecture GitHub and GitFlow Workflow branching strategy Agile environment experience Confidence in both written and spoken English And/or to have experience working with RabbitMQ/Kafka, Docker containerization and Domain driven design What does our tech stack look like? At Betsson, we pride ourselves on adaptability and keeping up with the latest technologies. There is always something fun to look forward to! CHALLENGE ACCEPTED? If you are interested to learn more, please apply with your CV in English. items.title: US External Affairs Manager, Global Affairs
items.description: About the Team OpenAI's mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The U.S. Policy and Partnerships team sits within Global Affairs and helps translate that mission into trusted, practical engagement with civil society, community leaders, researchers, and other external stakeholders across the United States. Our current operating model is built around disciplined, cross-functional campaigns: moving from abstract persuasion to local proof, pairing policy expertise with real-world use cases, and working with trusted validators who can help communities understand, shape, and benefit from AI. The team works closely with colleagues across Global Affairs, Legal, Safety, Communications, Product, Research, and other functions to build relationships that are substantive, durable, and grounded in two-way learning. About the Role As the U.S. External Affairs Manager, you will lead a portfolio spanning civil rights partnerships and federal AI policy, working with team leads to shape and advance OpenAI's engagement with civil rights organizations, civil society groups, researchers, and community-based organizations. This role combines independent strategic ownership, policy judgment, and external representation to help shape the AI policy debate in the United States. This role is central to the team's partnership and outreach operating model. You will help identify priority stakeholders, design engagement strategies, and build the external relationships and feedback loops. The work is not about one-way education; it is about co-design, listening, product and policy learning, and creating concrete proof points that can strengthen public trust. Reporting to the External Affairs Lead, you will work across the U.S. Policy and Partnerships team and in close coordination with State and Local Policy, Federal Affairs, Communications, Safety, Legal, Product, and Research. OpenAI is evolving quickly as we release new research, products, and tools. Day-to-day work may include representing OpenAI at convenings, designing a stakeholder strategy around a fast-moving policy issue, organizing partner briefings, preparing product and policy explainers, supporting local proof-point campaigns, coordinating quarterly partner reviews, or translating feedback from civil society into actionable insights for internal teams. This role is based in Washington, DC and may require frequent travel to meet with key stakeholders. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. In This Role, You Will - Develop and lead federal AI policy initiatives within your portfolio in partnership with Federal Affairs, connecting civil society priorities, community feedback, and practical use cases to OpenAI's policy positions and advocacy. - Build and maintain trusted relationships with civil rights, civil society, research, community, education, accessibility and other stakeholder organizations relevant to OpenAI's U.S. policy priorities. - Help execute a repeatable engagement operating model grounded in co-design, localized benefits, trusted validators, cross-functional planning, and regular partner reviews. - Develop stakeholder maps, engagement plans, briefing materials, and follow-up systems for priority policy campaigns and rapid-response moments. - Support federal and state engagement strategies by identifying credible third-party voices, local proof points, and community feedback that can inform policy positions and advocacy. - Represent OpenAI in senior-level policy discussions and external convenings, and prepare executives and subject-matter experts for meetings, roundtables, and public events, in coordination with Federal Affairs and relevant internal leads. - Translate complex AI product, safety, and policy topics into clear materials for external audiences, including standing content packs and deeper product briefings for technology policy stakeholders. - Surface external concerns and opportunities related to data and trust, deepfakes, child safety, job displacement, energy costs, copyright, civil and human rights, mental health, and other areas of public concern. - Coordinate closely with Global Affairs, Communications, Legal, Safety, Product, Research, and other internal teams to ensure stakeholder engagement is accurate, thoughtful, and useful to the business. - Track relationship health, engagement outcomes, commitments, risks, and follow-ups so the team can operate with accountability and continuity. You Might Thrive In This Role If You - Are deeply familiar with the civil society, civil rights, and technology policy landscape in the United States. - Are an effective coalition builder who can earn trust with a wide range of stakeholders, including groups that may be skeptical of OpenAI or AI more broadly. - Enjoy working in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where strategy, execution, and judgment all matter. - Can move easily between external relationship-building and internal cross-functional coordination. - Are comfortable translating technical and policy complexity into clear, useful materials for non-technical audiences. - Have strong instincts for where public trust, policy risk, and product reality intersect. - Are energized by the promise of AI while taking seriously its potential harms and uneven impacts. We’re looking for someone with: - Established network and credibility with civil society, civil rights, research, community, and other stakeholder organizations, including groups representing underrepresented communities. - Deep experience in technology policy, public policy, public affairs, civil society engagement, advocacy, campaigns, or a related field. - Strong understanding of the federal, state, and local policy institutions, processes, and debates shaping AI governance in the United States. - Demonstrated ability to design and execute stakeholder engagement strategies tied to concrete policy, partnership, or public trust objectives. - Excellent communication, presentation, briefing, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and policy concepts to diverse audiences. - Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage shared resources, timelines, follow-ups, and cross-functional workstreams. - Sound judgment, high integrity, and the ability to operate thoughtfully on sensitive or high-salience issues. - Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams, especially policy, communications, legal, safety, product, research, and technical teams. - Genuine care for the impact of technology on society and a demonstrated ability to listen carefully to external concerns. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Go-To-Market Compensation Lead
items.location_text: San Francisco, Austin, New York City
items.description: We’re looking for a Go-To-Market Compensation Lead to build and scale the incentive compensation programs that support our revenue growth. You’ll lead compensation design in partnership with the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM and Finance leadership, translating business priorities into plans that are clear, motivating, and financially sound. You’ll own commission operations end to end, including our incentive compensation management (ICM) system. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move from strategic recommendations to detailed execution, operate independently through ambiguity, and take extreme ownership of both the numbers and the employee experience. What you’ll do - Lead compensation design: Partner with the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM and Finance leadership to develop and evolve incentive plans across GTM roles. Recommend performance measures, payout structures, accelerators, and crediting rules that align incentives with company goals. - Model business impact: Build scenarios to assess compensation cost, earnings opportunities, and incentive alignment. Evaluate plan performance and recommend changes as our products, pricing, and go-to-market motion evolve. - Own commission operations: Run the full commission cycle, from source-data validation and crediting through calculations, reconciliation, approvals, and payroll handoff. Deliver accurate, on-time payouts and resolve questions and disputes with clear, consistent reasoning. - Own the ICM system: Lead system configuration, plan implementation, testing, administration, and ongoing improvements. Partner with systems and data teams to maintain reliable integrations and reduce manual work. - Build scalable processes and controls: Establish documentation, approval workflows, and audit trails for plans, exceptions, and adjustments. Create consistent processes for new hires, role changes, departures, and territory or account changes. - Make compensation understandable: Lead plan communications and enablement so employees and managers understand how incentives work. Be the trusted point of contact for compensation questions and complex edge cases. - Partner with Finance: Provide reliable payout reporting, accrual inputs, forecasts, and variance analysis. Maintain visibility into compensation spend and proactively flag risks or discrepancies. WHAT YOU BRING - Relevant experience: 4+ years of GTM compensation experience in SaaS or another high-growth industry, with meaningful ownership of both plan design and commission operations. - Autonomy and extreme ownership: A track record of setting priorities, identifying gaps, making sound recommendations, and driving work to completion without close supervision. You surface risks early and stay accountable through resolution. - Exceptional attention to detail: A rigorous approach to validating data, testing calculations, documenting decisions, and catching errors before they affect payouts. - Hands-on systems expertise: Experience administering an ICM platform and working with the CRM, finance, and payroll data that feed commission processes. - Strong analytical judgment: Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills, with the ability to evaluate trade-offs and turn complex analysis into practical recommendations. - Clear communication and partnership: The ability to influence senior stakeholders, explain complex compensation mechanics simply, and handle sensitive information with discretion. - Tact and sound judgment: The ability to handle exception and clarification requests from Sales tactfully, balancing responsiveness with consistent application of compensation policies. You know when to resolve requests independently and when to escalate to senior leadership with clear context and a recommendation. - AI perspective and drive: A strong perspective on how AI is changing traditional commissions and compensation plan processing, and a passion for putting that perspective into practice across the business while maintaining accuracy, transparency, and controls. NICE TO HAVE - Evolving business models: Experience with consumption-based, usage-based, or hybrid subscription models. - Systems implementation: Experience implementing or migrating an ICM platform and automating compensation workflows. - Technical fluency: SQL or BI skills to investigate data issues and improve reporting.

items.title: Compliance Specialist (12 months fixed-term)
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for a Compliance Specialist to build and maintain the compliance policy and procedure suites at Easygo - a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and livestreaming platforms. You’ll own the policy library across every market we operate in, with direct exposure to regulatory partners, legal counsel and heads of department. What you’ll build with us: You’ll assist with building the full policy and procedure suite for each new market from scratch, then keep it current as regulators update guidance and operational teams raise questions. You’ll also build and refine modular policy templates and use AI tools, including Claude, to speed up regulatory research and drafting across a policy library spanning multiple jurisdictions. You’ll work alongside the Senior Compliance Specialist, Senior Compliance Manager and Head of Compliance. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a 12 month fixed-term contract opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Assist with drafting the full policy and procedure suite for each new market, covering affiliate, VIP, marketing and advertising, customer support and complaints, sportsbook integrity, data privacy, payments, fraud risk and compliance strategy documents for regulatory submission. Adapt existing policy frameworks to new jurisdictions, working out what carries over directly, what needs amending for local requirements and what has to be built from scratch. Manage policy sign-off, coordinating internal review and documenting every required approval before policies reach operational teams. Liaise with local regulatory partners, in-market legal counsel and external consultants to clarify requirements where published guidance is limited or ambiguous, and flag gaps early. Maintain and update the policy library across all live markets as regulations change, processes evolve or audit findings need remediation. Monitor regulatory developments across active jurisdictions and flag material changes to the Senior Compliance Analyst. Act as the day-to-day compliance contact for operational teams, answering questions and giving written guidance on applying their obligations. Support control testing, audits and regulatory reporting with policy documents and market-specific materials, keeping version control and document registers across all markets in M-Files. Brief operational teams on requirements for new markets through workshops and written guidance, and coordinate sign-off with heads of department while tracking documentation milestones with the Program Manager. Use Jira for task tracking and sign-off workflows, and iterate on modular policy templates to cut build time for each new market. Your track record: A compliance, legal, regulatory or related background, with the ability to read legislation or regulatory guidance and extract what it means operationally. Strong written communication, producing policy documents that are accurate, clearly structured and practically useful to the teams they’re written for. Comfort using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow to work faster and more consistently, while applying your own judgement to validate and finalise outputs. Organised and detail-oriented across multiple concurrent workstreams, handling version control, status tracking and sign-off management without being asked. Proactive and self-directed, identifying what’s needed, flagging what’s missing and moving work forward independently, and saying so early when blocked. Comfort engaging stakeholders at all levels, including heads of department, legal counsel, regulatory partners and operational teams, in the same week. Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay, a performance-based bonus and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Deal Desk Lead
items.location_text: San Francisco, Austin, New York City
items.description: We’re looking for a Deal Desk Lead to help our GTM teams structure and close deals that support durable revenue growth. You’ll partner with the field, the Head of Revenue Operations, and Finance and Legal leadership to balance customer needs with company priorities. You’ll own Deal Desk end to end and build the team as we grow. This is a hands-on role for someone who moves with urgency and finds workable solutions, not simply obstacles or approval paths. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Partner with the field: Engage early on complex opportunities, understand customer needs, and remove obstacles to close. Bring Sales, Finance, and Legal together to resolve issues quickly. - Structure deals and balance trade-offs: Shape pricing, discounts, commitments, and payment terms. Weigh customer value, revenue, profitability, and risk, offering practical alternatives rather than a simple yes or no. - Own review and approvals: Run a responsive process for nonstandard deals and exceptions. Apply policies consistently and escalate decisions beyond your authority with clear options and a recommendation. - Ensure accurate execution: Ensure quotes, order forms, approvals, and CRM records reflect agreed terms. Resolve discrepancies before signature and enable clean handoffs to billing and post-sale teams. - Own quote-to-order requirements and delivery: Define business requirements, priorities, and acceptance criteria for quote-to-order workflows. Hold Systems accountable for building and delivering against them, owning business acceptance testing and sign-off. - Scale the function: Build playbooks, approval frameworks, and field enablement that reduce recurring friction. Use deal and exception patterns to recommend improvements to pricing and commercial policy. Hire, coach, and develop the Deal Desk team as the business grows. WHAT YOU BRING - Relevant experience: 4+ years in Deal Desk, commercial operations, or a related function in SaaS or another high-growth industry, including complex deal structuring and approvals. - Exceptional business partnership: A track record of earning Sales’ trust through responsiveness, practical solutions, and sound commercial judgment that protects the business. - Autonomy and extreme ownership: The ability to prioritize independently, surface risks early, and drive issues to resolution without close supervision. - Commercial judgment and precision: Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail across deal economics, terms, and documentation, even under tight deadlines. You distinguish material risks from issues that should not hold up a deal. - Tact and communication: The ability to handle Sales exception and clarification requests tactfully, influence stakeholders, and escalate to senior leadership appropriately. - Hands-on systems expertise: Experience with CRM, quoting or CPQ tools, and approval workflows, plus the ability to translate field needs into actionable business requirements. - AI perspective and drive: A strong perspective on how AI is changing traditional quote-to-order workflows, and a passion for putting that perspective into practice across the business. - People management: Experience managing and developing direct reports, with the ability to build a team while remaining hands-on. NICE TO HAVE - Evolving business models: Experience with consumption-based, usage-based, or hybrid subscription models. - Enterprise complexity: Experience with enterprise procurement and multiyear agreements.

items.title: Sales Development - Japan
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Sales Development (SDR) based in Japan, at ElevenLabs you will play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL - Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market. - Engage in outbound activities such as cold calling, emailing, and social media outreach to initiate contact with potential customers - Implement personalized and effective outreach campaigns to maximize lead conversion. - Collaborate closely with the Account Executive to exchange insights on prospect feedback, objections, and market trends. - Continuously refine and adjust outreach strategies based on the feedback loop. - Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to outbound sales activities, including conversion rates, lead quality, and outreach effectiveness. - Collaborate with the sales leadership to analyze data and optimize strategies for better results. REQUIREMENTS - 2-3 years outbound B2B sales experience with a track record of securing new business meetings. - Demonstrated ability to build Opportunity sized lead lists in new markets and categories - Experience with full suite of prospecting tools - Demonstrated ability to build, scale process - Demonstrated ability to nurture a team - Curiosity - asking insightful questions and developing solutions from a foundation of knowledge and insight. - Self-motivated, thriving as part of a team while possessing the ability to stay driven and proactive independently. - Effective time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage a high volume of leads. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Japanese Location This role is remote-first, however there is a preference for candidates to be based in Tokyo with the option to work out of one of our offices. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

TL;DR: This is a 12-week summer 2027 internship on the Tech Sourcing team in Coinbase's Source to Pay (S2P) group, covering software, SaaS, AI, and cloud spend. You'll run analysis projects that turn vendor and renewal data into clear recommendations, and support live sourcing work. The Source to Pay (S2P) team manages Coinbase's full third-party lifecycle, including strategic sourcing, third-party risk management, procurement-to-pay, and travel and expense. We serve as the primary point of contact for vendors across every category, partnering with cross-functional teams to keep processes clear, efficient, and compliant. items.title: Member of Data Staff (Data Acceleration)
items.description: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. This role brings that same standard to how our data team works, with AI at the center of everything we do. We're looking for someone who's been a great data scientist, analytics engineer, or data engineer: the kind of person who knows which metric actually matters, can design an A/B test that answers the real question, has gone deep on a data model because something didn't add up, and has decided that the highest-leverage thing they can do next is build AI systems that fundamentally change how data science gets done. You'll build AI agents and internal systems that can increasingly handle end-to-end analysis workflows: forming hypotheses, writing and running queries, interpreting results, and drafting recommendations with the right evaluation, review, and guardrails. You'll build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let AI systems query the warehouse reliably. You'll create workflows that detect, diagnose, and help fix data issues before they become company-wide problems. You'll build the infrastructure that multiplies what a small data team can ship. You'll join a data team that's already using AI across its work. The next step is turning those individual workflows into scalable systems, shared tools, and an AI-native operating model that becomes a benchmark for how modern data teams work. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build AI agents that do data science - not just SQL copilots, but systems that can safely explore data, form hypotheses, run queries, interpret results, and generate actionable recommendations with clear evaluation and human review loops. - Make AI systems query the warehouse reliably - build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let agents use our semantic context and metadata accurately. - Accelerate the AI-native data workflow - turn the best existing AI-assisted workflows into repeatable systems, reusable tools, and patterns the whole data team can adopt. - Automate the data lifecycle - build self-healing pipelines, automated dbt model generation and validation, data quality agents, and diagnosis workflows that reduce manual firefighting. - Ship AI-powered experiment analysis - build agents that interpret A/B test results, flag statistical issues, identify likely drivers, and draft ship/no-ship recommendations. - Turn the data team into a product team - build internal data products that stakeholders use every day, replacing ad hoc requests with self-serve AI interfaces. - Own the full lifecycle - identify high-leverage problems, prototype with LLMs, evaluate accuracy, design the UX, ship to production, and monitor quality over time. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in data science, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role. You've been close enough to real data work to know what should and should not be automated. - Deep SQL and analytics judgment - you can reason through metrics, experiments, data models, and messy warehouse reality without relying on a tool to think for you. - Strong product sense - you understand what stakeholders actually need, what makes a workflow adoptable, and how to turn a prototype into a product people use. - Hands-on LLM experience - you've built with frontier models, agents, RAG systems, evals, or AI-powered workflows and have opinions about where they work and where they fail. - Pipeline and modeling fluency - you've worked with dbt, warehouse schemas, data quality issues, and the practical tradeoffs behind durable data systems. - Builder mentality - you see a manual process and immediately think about how to systematize it. You ship fast, measure quality, and iterate. - Autonomy - this is a new function. You'll help define the roadmap as much as execute it. BONUS - Experience building production AI agents or agent evaluation systems. - Experience with Snowflake, semantic layers, or metadata systems. - Experience building internal tools, Slack bots, CLIs, or developer productivity products that people actually used. - Strong experimentation background, including metric design and statistical interpretation. - Experience with BI tools and the judgment to know what should be automated versus kept human-reviewed. - Early-stage startup experience. WHY THIS ROLE - Set the standard for the industry - Perplexity's data team is already using AI across its work. You'll turn that into something other data teams look to as the benchmark. - Build AI with AI - Perplexity builds AI for people who expect more. You'll bring that same level of ambition to how the company works with data. - Frontier models, day one - you're at an AI company with access to frontier infrastructure and people who deeply understand what's possible. - Massive leverage - the systems you build will multiply the output of every data team member and every stakeholder who needs data. - Direct impact - small team, no layers of approval. Idea to shipped system in days, not quarters.
